registry: VCG Feature Scanner scientific methodology source lock

sources.title: Criteria to Assess the Predictive and Clinical Utility of Novel Models, Biomarkers, and Tools for Risk of Cardiovascular Disease
sources.implementation_scope: Discrimination, incremental performance, reproducibility, clinical utility, subgroup generalizability, equity and cost-value interpretation
platform_safeguards: VCG is compared with established ECG baselines on the same assessable cohort
incremental claims require paired validation evidence
clinical utility plots require validated calibrated probability models
subgroup and stability audits are reported separately

sources.title: TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods
sources.implementation_scope: Transparent reporting of development and evaluation data, outcomes, predictors, missing data, performance, subgroups, open science and limitations
platform_safeguards: development, validation and locked test are named unambiguously
subject-level splitting and missingness are explicit
all manifests pin data, code, rules, panels and package versions
reports distinguish marker association from probability-model evaluation

sources.title: PROBAST+AI: an updated quality, risk of bias, and applicability assessment tool for prediction models using regression or artificial intelligence methods
sources.implementation_scope: Risk-of-bias and applicability audit across participants, predictors, outcomes and analysis
platform_safeguards: future information is excluded from predictive inputs
thresholds, directions and scaling are learned on train only
validation is a single selection gate and locked test remains sealed
event-per-parameter, calibration, missingness and overfitting rules are enforced

notes: Bibliographic metadata and implementation safeguards only. Any edit changes the SHA-256 included in validation and freeze provenance.
